content.value: Primary reading: Rozanski and Woods, Chapters 20-22. Supplemental: arc42 architecture documentation guidance. This unit focuses on deployment viewpoint.

The deployment viewpoint maps software elements onto infrastructure. It covers nodes, networks, regions, containers, storage, middleware, runtime platforms, availability zones, and environment differences.
Deployment structure affects latency, capacity, resilience, security, cost, observability, and release safety. It is where many abstract qualities become operationally concrete.
Studio: map three containers to cloud infrastructure and identify one latency risk, one availability risk, and one cost driver.

concepts.name: Deployment viewpoint
concepts.description: A viewpoint focused on mapping software elements to infrastructure, runtime nodes, networks, and environments.

concepts.name: Runtime node
concepts.description: A physical, virtual, or managed environment that hosts software execution or storage.

concepts.name: Deployment environment
concepts.description: A configured setting such as development, staging, production, region, or tenant where software runs.

concepts.name: Infrastructure mapping
concepts.description: The allocation of software elements to compute, storage, network, and managed platform resources.
